title: A reviewer can feed a command text to a guard hook as data, without the refusal for naming git
why: Incident (consultant 20:58 CST Nov 14, it speaks for the owner under ruling own-consultant-speaks-for-owner; triage read no refusal text; n=1 this evening): the round-1 reviewer of lane g1 on #3435 (20:55 CST) could not run four archive-gate probes, because the reviewer's isolation refuses any command text that names git. The read was unknown, and the lane ran the probes by hand. Harm: a guard stops a reviewer from proving a guard. Under the owner's 20:18 words (ruling own-goal-stale-guard-is-stale) a guard that blocks the 20:17 goal is stale; a lane fixes it, and review rounds and red-first stay. Want (consultant): a reviewer may feed a command text to the guard hook as data (nothing executes) without the git-name refusal. Red case first: a reviewer probe that names git as data is refused today. Guard identity UNREAD by triage: the same refusal text ("too complex to verify that it stays inside the worktree") has been the Claude Code harness's worktree isolation, not a claude-settings guard (steps harness-worktree-git-probe, reviewer-probe-helper, scratch-git-in-isolated-agent; a grep of main found nothing then). If the refusal is the harness's, this step ends as a note and the fix is upstream (owner item 462, harness-worktree-issue, holds the draft); the repo-side fix is a helper that takes the text as an argument and never runs it. Kin: reviewer-probe-helper (done: a helper for reviewer probes, #2325; whether it takes a text that names git is unread), worktree-git-refusal-measure (counts refusals vs real catches), red-worktree-guard-false-alarm-read, worktree-add-refused-false-alarm. First act of a lane: find which rule refuses the text (the harness or a repo hook; read the refusal text itself), and measure how often a reviewer is blocked this way (count from records; else say unmeasured). Must not let a real git command run: the probe feeds text to the hook only. Guard change: review rounds and the net-value test apply. Rule: building-mistake-names-its-guard.
